tests.name: sixteen_digits_neon_sse2
tests.intent: Probe sixteen_digits via layout_decimal and layout_float for float and double types with 16-17 digit inputs.

tests.name: layout_decimal_sign_and_exp
tests.intent: Probe layout_decimal with negative numbers and explicit exponents outside the 16-17 digit range.

tests.name: coordinate_float_precision
tests.intent: Probe coordinate_float with 16 or 17 digit numbers without exponents resembling GeoJSON coordinates.

tests.name: locate_token_bounds
tests.intent: Probe locate_token indirectly via serializer dump for tokens requiring specific decimal exponents and fixed-point positions.

tests.name: mask_and_select_if
tests.intent: Probe mask_if and select_if internal logic via token digitization paths during serialization of floats.

tests.name: four_digit_text_conversion
tests.intent: Probe four_digit_text via float serialization batching mechanism for replacing last four digits.

tests.name: readonly_coordinate_pair_optimization
tests.intent: Probe the optimization for a pair of floats in an array without a frame during serialization.

tests.name: float_batch_capacity_limit
tests.intent: Probe float_batch capacity handling by serializing an array containing more than 256 consecutive float elements.

tests.name: float_batch_storage_heap_allocation
tests.intent: Probe heap allocation of float_batch storage on first float conversion during view serialization.

tests.name: coordinate_bits_subnormal_zero
tests.intent: Probe coordinate_bits handling edge cases such as zero and values near subnormals.

tests.name: token_digits_exact_tie
tests.intent: Probe token_digits_1 and token_digits_2 fallback behavior when exact ties between candidates occur.

tests.name: biased_distance_computation
tests.intent: Probe biased_distance function via token digit calculations during serialization rounding.

tests.name: layout_float_direct_eisel_lemire
tests.intent: Probe layout_float directly invoking Eisel-Lemire for tokens with 16 or more digits.

tests.name: write_double_ahead_mixed_nodes
tests.intent: Probe write_double_ahead with mixed float and non-float nodes inside a JSON document.

tests.name: batched_float_decision_loop
tests.intent: Probe batched float classification loop ahead of tree walk during view serialization.

tests.name: coordinate_float_fallback_short
tests.intent: Probe coordinate_float returning false for short tokens under 16 digits, falling back to standard parsing.

tests.name: float_carried_rounding_flag
tests.intent: Probe carried rounding flags when serialization token replacement carries beyond the last four digits.

tests.name: multiple_batch_scans_in_walk
tests.intent: Probe multiple sequential batch scans across large arrays during tree walk serialization.

tests.name: edited_float_fallback_serializer
tests.intent: Probe edited_float fallback paths when a float node has been modified via the editing API.

tests.name: simd_vector_little_endian_edge_cases
tests.intent: Probe SIMD vector and little-endian code paths with boundary digit counts (exactly 16 digits).
